# Chinese Language Institute (CLI)

> > Chinese Language Institute offers Mandarin immersion programs in Guilin, China, with comprehensive resources for learning Chinese language and culture.

CLI (Chinese Language Institute) provides study abroad programs, online Chinese courses, graded readers organized by HSK level, and extensive cultural resources. Based in Guilin, Guangxi province, CLI specializes in Mandarin immersion education with materials covering Chinese characters, holidays, culture, and travel throughout China.

## Key Topics

- CLI (Chinese Language Institute)
- Mandarin Chinese learning
- Guilin immersion programs
- HSK (Chinese proficiency test)
- Chinese culture and customs
- Study abroad in China
- Chinese characters and writing
- Graded readers for learners
- Chinese holidays and festivals
- Tea culture
- Language immersion methodology
- Guangxi province
- Li River region
- Chinese wedding customs
- Beginner to advanced Chinese

## Study Programs in Guilin

- [Why Guilin? | The Chinese Language Institute](https://studycli.org/guilin): Guilin's advantages as ideal Mandarin immersion study destination for CLI
- [Top 10 Reasons to Study Chinese in Guilin | Chinese Language Institute](https://studycli.org/study-abroad-in-china/10-reasons-to-study-mandarin-in-guilin): Key benefits of studying Mandarin in Guilin through CLI's immersion program
- [Application Form | The Chinese Language Institute](https://studycli.org/apply): CLI program application for Immersion, Study Abroad, and Teach in China

## Learning Mandarin Chinese

- [Top 5 Reasons Why You Should Learn Chinese | CLI](https://studycli.org/learn-chinese/why-learn-chinese): Key motivations for learning Mandarin: career, culture, and opportunities
- [The Four Drivers of Language Learning - CLI](https://studycli.org/learn-chinese/the-four-drivers-of-language-learning): Framework for effective language acquisition: environment, study, interaction
- [Chinese Learning Tips (2020) | The Chinese Language Institute](https://studycli.org/learn-chinese/things-to-know-before-you-learn-mandarin): Essential tips covering tones, pinyin, and grammar for Mandarin beginners
- [Recommended Chinese Textbooks | The Chinese Language Institute](https://studycli.org/learn-chinese/chinese-textbooks): CLI's curated recommendations for Chinese textbooks and learning materials
- [How many characters are there in Chinese? | Chinese Language Institute](https://studycli.org/chinese-characters/number-of-characters-in-chinese): Explanation of total Chinese character count and classification systems

## HSK Graded Readers

- [HSK 1 | My Dad Loves Drinking Tea | CLI Graded Readers](https://studycli.org/graded-readers/my-dad-loves-drinking-tea): HSK 1 beginner graded reader about tea culture with pinyin and bilingual text
- [HSK 6 | Wedding Conventions in Modern China | CLI Graded Readers](https://studycli.org/graded-readers/wedding-conventions-in-modern-china): HSK 6 graded reader exploring modern Chinese wedding customs and culture

## Chinese Culture and Customs

- [Ultimate Guide to Chinese Names and Surnames | CLI](https://studycli.org/chinese-culture/chinese-names): Chinese naming conventions, surnames, and character selection customs guide
- [Christmas in China Explained! | Ultimate Christmas in China Guide](https://studycli.org/chinese-holidays/christmas-in-china): How Christmas is celebrated in China: history and modern practices guide
- [Chinese Holidays 2026 | The Chinese Language Institute](https://studycli.org/chinese-holidays/2026): Official 2026 Chinese public holidays and lunar calendar observances list

## Travel and Living in China

- [Hangzhou Travel Guide | Top Things to Do in Hangzhou | CLI](https://studycli.org/travel-china/hangzhou-china): Hangzhou travel guide featuring West Lake, tea culture, and top attractions
- [Top 10 WeChat Accounts To Follow - CLI](https://studycli.org/learn-chinese-online/top-10-wechat-accounts-to-follow): Curated WeChat official accounts for Chinese learners and expats in China
- [The Most Popular Foodie in China - CLI](https://studycli.org/travel-china/the-most-popular-foodie-in-china): Profile of Trevor James 'The Food Ranger' and Chinese street food culture

## Optional

- [What are the most spoken languages in the world? | CLI](https://studycli.org/learn-chinese/most-spoken-languages-in-world): Overview of world's most spoken languages with Mandarin Chinese statistics
- [CLI Welcomes New Students! - CLI](https://studycli.org/blog/cli-welcomes-new-students): New semester welcome featuring student activities and cultural excursions
- [Students Go Swimming to Find Chinese Culture - CLI](https://studycli.org/blog/students-go-swimming-to-find-chinese-culture): Student weekend cultural immersion activity in Guilin's karst countryside
- [Photos of Guilin Locals - CLI](https://studycli.org/guilin/photos-of-guilin-locals): Portrait photography of Guilin residents by former Creative Director Jeff Fried
